div.head: IX Atr Prol.
div.ab: Ðis is sio gerædnes, þe Æþelred cyning and ealle his ƿitan æt Ƿudustoce geræddan.
(Incip.) Ðis is sio gerædnes þe Æþelred cyning and ealle his witan æt Wudustoce geræddan.
Ðis is sio gerædnes þe Æþelred cyning and ealle his witan æt Wudustoce geræddan.
IX Atr. Prol. Dies ist die Verordnung, die König Aethelred und alle seine Witan zu Woodstock beschlossen haben.
IX Atr. Prologue. This is the ordinance which King Æthelred and all his witan decided at Woodstock.
This is the ordinance which King Æthelred and all his councillors have determined upon at Woodstock.

Manuscripts: MS = London, British Library, Cotton MS Otho A.x. Since the manuscript was almost completely destroyed in the Ashburnam House fire of 1731, this edition relies on the text of Liebermann, Gesetze, vol. 1, p. 269.
Due to damage to the manuscript, this text is based on that found in Liebermann, Die Gesetze der Angelsachsen.

Woodstock: Woodstock, Oxfordshire, had been the site of an earlier meeting of the royal council in approximately 997, at which the legislation 1 Æthelred was issued. The meeting at which this text was compiled likely took place between 1008 and 1016.
